The MAX98357A takes standard I2S audio, which every ESP32, ESP32-S2, ESP32-S3, ESP32-C3 and ESP32-C6 can send, using three GPIOs (BCLK, LRC, DIN) plus power and ground. It also works with a Raspberry Pi and other boards that have an I2S output. The XIAO ESP32S3 Sense is only one example.Which pins do I use on a XIAO ESP32S3 Sense?Any three of D0–D5 for BCLK, LRC and DIN, set in your I2S code. The camera and the onboard microphone use other pins, so audio in, audio out and video can run together. Cut the plug off and strip the leads to use the amplifier's screw terminal, or solder them to its + and − pads.What is the diode for?Seeed advises a Schottky diode in series when you power the XIAO's 5V pin from an external supply: anode to the supply, cathode to the 5V pin. The 1N5819 does that with a drop of about 0.3–0.45 V. Use it with the 30 cm lead when you run 5 V from the duck's body up to the head.Is there a microphone in the kit?No. The XIAO ESP32S3 Sense has its own digital microphone. For a board without one, add an I2S microphone such as the INMP441.How loud is it?Up to 1.8 W into the 8 Ω speaker at 5 V. 3.3 V or 5 V logic XIAO ESP32S3 Sense: with the camera and microphone in use, D0–D5 are free for BCLK, LRC and DIN; the microSD slot shares D8–D10 Original ESP32-CAM boards: the camera uses most of the pins, so an ESP32-S3 board is easier Power: 2.5–5.5 V; use 5 V for full volume Speaker: 8 Ω 2 W; the amplifier gives up to 1.8 W into 8 Ω at 5 V, inside its rating Specifications Amplifier MAX98357A I2S digital-input class-D mono amplifier board, 2.5–5.5 V, 1.8 W into 8 Ω or 3.2 W into 4 Ω at 5 V (10 % THD), gain 9 dB default (3–15 dB selectable), 8–96 kHz, no MCLK needed Amplifier pins LRC, BCLK, DIN, GAIN, SD, GND, Vin; The MAX98357A takes standard I2S audio, which every ESP32, ESP32-S2, ESP32-S3, ESP32-C3 and ESP32-C6 can send, using three GPIOs (BCLK, LRC, DIN) plus power and ground. It also works with a Raspberry Pi and other boards that have an I2S output. The XIAO ESP32S3 Sense is only one example.Which pins do I use on a XIAO ESP32S3 Sense?Any three of D0–D5 for BCLK, LRC and DIN, set in your I2S code. The camera and the onboard microphone use other pins, so audio in, audio out and video can run together. The microSD slot shares D8–D10.How do I connect the speaker?The speaker leads end in a 2-pin 2.0 mm plug. Cut the plug off and strip the leads to use the amplifier's screw terminal, or solder them to its + and − pads.What is the diode for?Seeed advises a Schottky diode in series when you power the XIAO's 5V pin from an external supply: anode to the supply, cathode to the 5V pin. The 1N5819 does that with a drop of about 0.3–0.45 V. Use it with the 30 cm lead when you run 5 V from the duck's body up to the head.Is there a microphone in the kit?No. The XIAO ESP32S3 Sense has its own digital microphone. For a board without one, add an I2S microphone such as the INMP441.How loud is it?Up to 1.8 W into the 8 Ω speaker at 5 V.
